text: Tell me about a time you worked in a team to achieve a goal. What was your role and what was the outcome?
Describe a time you disagreed with a colleague or teammate. How did you handle it?
Tell me about a time you faced a difficult problem at work or university. How did you approach solving it?
Give an example of a time you had to adapt quickly to a major change. What did you do?
Describe a goal you set for yourself that was difficult to reach. How did you stay motivated and what happened?
Tell me about a time you took the lead on a project or task without being asked.
Tell me about a time you made a mistake. How did you handle it and what did you learn?
Describe a time you had to explain something complicated to someone with no background in the topic.
Tell me about a time you had several competing deadlines. How did you decide what to do first?
Describe a time you did the right thing even though it was difficult or unpopular.
Tell me about a time you motivated others to get a task done.
Imagine a teammate is not completing their share of a group task and the deadline is close. What would you do?
You realise you have made an error in a report that has already been sent to your manager. What do you do?
Your priorities change suddenly halfway through a project. How would you respond?
You are given a task you have never done before and little guidance. How would you get started?
You notice a colleague bending a company rule to hit their targets. What would you do?
You are leading a small group and two members strongly disagree on the approach. How do you resolve it?
Why are you interested in this role and our company?
What motivates you to do your best work?
Where do you see yourself in five years, and how does this role fit into that?
What is your greatest strength, and how has it helped you achieve something?
Tell me about a university project or society activity you are proud of and what you contributed.
How have you balanced your studies with other commitments such as work, sport or volunteering?
Describe a time you learned a new skill quickly outside the classroom.
Why did you choose your degree, and how will it help you in this internship or graduate programme?
Tell me about a time you went above and beyond to help a customer.
A customer is upset and shouting about a problem that is not your fault. How do you handle the conversation?
Describe a time you had to say no to a customer or client. How did you do it?
How would you find out what a customer really needs when they are not sure themselves?
Describe a time you used data or analysis to make or support a decision.
Tell me about a technical or analytical problem you solved. Walk me through your process step by step.
